npc_osk_pieman.name: Osk
npc_osk_pieman.look: A round, red-faced man in his forties with floury forearms, a white baker's cap, a stained apron over a brown tunic and a big wooden pie-paddle under his arm.
npc_osk_pieman.personality: Jolly with customers and a terror to thieves; generous to anyone who works, mean to anyone who takes.
npc_osk_pieman.values: his pies, honest trade, a hard day's work
npc_osk_pieman.fears: thieves, a cold oven, a bad market
npc_osk_pieman.concerns: The oven needs kindling split for the morning bake, and he's dead on his feet. Street children have been lifting his pies all week.

price.text: A pie costs a copper, or a bit of honest work.
price.line: A copper a pie. Or work for it: there's always something wants doing.
price.lead: Osk sells a pie for a copper, or for a bit of honest work.

kit.text: Kit, the urchin by the crates, has been stealing his pies all week.
kit.line: See that one by the crates? Little thief. Had three pies off me this week.
kit.lead: Osk says Kit the urchin has been stealing his pies.

npc_osk_pieman.style: Loud and jolly; calls everyone 'friend' until they cross him.

samples: Pies! Last pies of the day!
No copper? Then there's work, friend.
voice.habits: Wipes his hands on his apron; counts his pies; shouts for Hobb.
voice.never: gives a pie to a thief
voice.greeting: Beams: 'Last pies of the day, friend!'

goals: Get kindling split for the morning

superstition.text: Osk would want to know how it works.

offers.task: split the logs by the oven into kindling for the morning bake
offers.check: Has the stranger split the logs into kindling?

npc_hobb_watchman.name: Hobb
npc_hobb_watchman.look: A big, slow, grizzled man in his fifties in a dented iron cap and a quilted watch coat with the town's badge, a cudgel at his belt and a lantern in his hand.
npc_hobb_watchman.personality: Slow, thorough and fair: catches thieves, but lets go anyone who puts things right.
npc_hobb_watchman.values: the market's peace, the law, a quiet night
npc_hobb_watchman.authority: The market's watchman: he can seize thieves and throw them out.
npc_hobb_watchman.concerns: Pies keep going missing from Osk's stall and he's not caught the thief. He watches strangers.

law.text: A thief who gives back what they took and pays for it walks free; one who won't goes in the stocks.
law.line: Give it back and pay up, and we'll say no more. Don't, and it's the stocks.
law.lead: In Wendford market, a thief who gives back and pays walks free.

samples: I've got my eye on you.
Put it back and we'll say no more.
voice.habits: Walks the hall slowly, swinging his lantern; stops to stare.
voice.greeting: Looks you over: 'Evening. Hall's closing soon.'

npc_osk_pieman.text: a good man with a loud mouth

npc_kit_urchin.text: poor little wretch, and a thief

superstition.text: Hobb would want to know how it works.

npc_kit_urchin.name: Kit
npc_kit_urchin.look: A thin, sharp-faced girl of about eleven with cropped dark hair, a filthy oversized coat, bare feet and a quick, sly grin.
npc_kit_urchin.personality: Quick, sly and starving; brave until caught, then terrified. Loyal to anyone who feeds her.
npc_kit_urchin.values: food, not getting caught, her little brother at home
npc_kit_urchin.concerns: She hasn't eaten since yesterday. She's been lifting Osk's pies, and Hobb is getting close.

plan.text: If someone makes a fuss at the cloth stall, Osk always looks away, and a pie can be lifted.
plan.line: Want a pie? Easy. Go and make a fuss by the cloth stall. He always looks. I'll do the rest.
plan.lead: Kit says Osk looks away when there's a fuss at the cloth stall.

hobb.text: Hobb lets thieves go if they give back and pay.
hobb.line: Hobb's soft, really. Give it back and say sorry and he lets you off.
hobb.lead: Kit says Hobb lets thieves go if they give back and pay.

npc_kit_urchin.persuaded_by: food, or someone being kind to her
npc_kit_urchin.style: Fast whispers, slang, and a grin.

samples: Psst. You hungry? I know a way.
Don't look at him. Look at me.
voice.habits: Watches Osk's stall; keeps to the shadows; whispers.

tasks.doing: hiding by the crates, watching the pies

superstition.text: Kit would want to know how it works.
